Hi there! For a successful contact import, your CSV must include the required headers **email**, **name**, and **company**. You can also add any of the optional headers such as **phone**, **title**, or any custom‑field names you’ve already defined in the workspace – the importer will match them by name. Extra columns are ignored, so they won’t block the import. If you want the exact spelling, you can download the sample template from the import screen.

Let me know if you need any more help!
